title: Image Analysis
description: Allows to analyze image content and the detection of noise. It is possible to set the sensitivity of the detection to accurately highlight the noise and then use the removal of this noise to improve the quality of the image.

title: Crop
description: Crop the image manually or use automatic fit crop to remove unwanted margins.

title: Brush
description: Paint directly onto the image using an adjustable brush. Includes eraser mode for precise corrections.

title: Pencil
description: Draw precise strokes with a fine pencil tool. Ideal for annotations and detailed edits.

title: Rectangle
description: Add a rectangular vector shape with adjustable fill, stroke, and opacity.

title: Ellipse
description: Insert an ellipse shape with configurable dimensions, fill, and stroke.

title: Line
description: Draw a straight line with adjustable thickness, color, and opacity.

title: Select
description: Select, move, duplicate, or delete objects. Supports multi-selection.

title: Resize
description: Resize the image with optional aspect ratio locking for precise dimension control.

title: Rotate
description: Rotate the image by fixed angles.

title: Flip
description: Flip the image horizontally or vertically.

title: Grayscale
description: Convert the image to grayscale using multiple conversion algorithms.

title: Background Removal (Automatic)
description: Automatically detect and remove the background.

title: Background Removal (Manual)
description: Manually mark areas to keep or remove for precise background editing.

title: Background Removal (Color)
description: Remove background by selecting a specific color range with adjustable tolerance.

title: Blur Area
description: Apply a blur effect to a selected region. Adjust strength and edge fade.

title: Text
description: Insert and edit text with control over font, size, color, and opacity.

title: Magnify Area
description: Zoom into a selected area with customizable radius, zoom factor, and outline.

title: Frame
description: Add visual frames such as solid borders, browser frames, or device mockups.

title: Create Preset
description: Save the current configuration of operations as a reusable preset.

title: My Presets
description: Apply a previously saved preset to quickly reproduce a sequence of edits.
